$comment: HZ-398: the contract for domain/providers.json — every agent provider, its label and the models an owner may pick for a step. Validated by domain/validate.mjs, the same Draft-07 subset validator the other domain/ schemas use (no `pattern`). Rules the subset cannot express — provider names matching ^[a-z]+$ and unique, `default` naming a declared provider, model ids matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*$ (no colon, so a stored "<provider>:<model id>" choice splits unambiguously) and unique across ALL providers, and `defaultModel` being null or one of its own provider's ids — are asserted at LOAD time by assertProvidersShape() in domain/js/providers.js and _validate_source() in domain/py/providers.py, which domain/fixtures/providers-cases.json drives from both sides. The persona bindings check every domain/personas.json models id is declared under the default provider.
title: Horizon agent providers and their selectable models

default.$comment: The provider a step runs on when nobody chose one. Its models come from domain/personas.json's `models` block, so its defaultModel is null.

providers.$comment: ARRAY ORDER IS THE ORDER the picker lists providers in; model order within a provider is the picker's option order.

defaultModel.$comment: The model this provider runs when nobody chose one — pinned here so a provider CLI update cannot silently change it. null means domain/personas.json's `models` block decides (the default provider only).

selectable.$comment: false: declared so a domain/personas.json `models` entry may name it (the concierge's), but never offered as a step choice.
